swiss.official_conflict_handling: Advance a drawn team to the next available position if its placement causes an immediate or forced later conflict.
swiss.official_no_valid_draw_exception: Officials may waive rematch avoidance if no eligible draw exists.

draw_implementation.default_algorithm: Uniformly randomize the ball order within each record group. Place each ball into the earliest slot permitting a complete rematch-free pairing. Enumerate the induced weights over all ball permutations and sample from those weights.
draw_implementation.sensitivity_algorithm: Sample uniformly among legal unordered perfect matchings, without claiming this is the official draw distribution.
draw_implementation.no_valid_matching_model_fallback: Use an unrestricted random pairing only if no legal matching exists; report every invocation as a discretionary-waiver assumption.
draw_implementation.global_completion_check_scope: remaining slots of the current record-group draw, not unknown future match results

first_selection.swiss_game_1: higher regional seed; equal seeds use coinflip or an equivalent method such as applicable draw order
first_selection.quarterfinal_game_1: better Swiss record; equal records use draw order

fearless_draft.reported_rule: A champion picked by either team is unavailable to either team for the remaining games of that series; resets for a new series.
fearless_draft.verification_status: 2026_secondary_format_confirmation; primary international rules explicitly handle Fearless selection errors but do not fully define Fearless operation
fearless_draft.primary_evidence_boundary: Both the Worlds-specific rules and the 2026 International Events Competition Ruleset v1.1 were retrieved. International sections 4.5.6-4.5.7 handle unavailable Fearless champion picks/bans. Neither retrieved PDF expressly defines both-team carryover, ordinary-ban carryover, game-5 reset, or the Worlds-specific scope of Fearless series.

verified_primary_selection_error_rules.unavailable_champion_pick: Restart champion selection at the error so it can be corrected

optional_sensitivity.distribution: Beta-binomial mixture; independent latent probability for each series

update_support.known_matches: Swiss results with round/a/b/winner; completed rounds form a contiguous prefix
update_support.announced_rounds: Complete pairings for current or next Swiss round after previous rounds complete
update_support.quarterfinal_bracket: Four ordered pairs; matches 0/1 share one half, 2/3 share the other; all Swiss results required
update_support.known_knockout: stage/a/b/winner records; full quarterfinal history before observed semifinals and both semifinal results before observed final
